Build and xpcshell registration expose the new modules/tests; no test was executed.",
        "storeObserver takes its selector map as the first constructor argument and subscribes there. applyInitialState is explicit because subclass setup must finish first. It compares selector results with strict equality and calls handleStateChange only on a changed result; an initial undefined result need not produce a callback. dispose invokes the unsubscribe function.",
        "selectValue has a rest-argument array and checks !args. That array is always truthy, so the no-argument cache-return branch is not reached; the method evaluates the selector directly. Store-change detection only passes state, so extra external selector arguments are not part of update detection. These are actual limits, not assumed behavior from the comment.",
        "Preference slices transform values entering Redux but write action.payload to an existing typed preference in set effects. sync handles external pref changes; reset clears the user value. The invalid-pref-type branch throws inside the listener effect, with imported middleware error propagation unverified. A fallback alone does not create a typed preference.",
        "Extra reducers generate their own actions but only built-in set/reset and Boolean actions have the installed persistence effects. The baz integration action changes Redux while the raw pref remains lorem. The Boolean toggle uses original store state before writing the inverted pref.",
        "XUL store initialization reads through XULStoreUtils and its set reducer itself writes the payload before returning it. It installs no external XUL-store observer. Direct reducer and integration assertions check persistence; automatic synchronization from later external writes is not established.",
        "All new preference/XUL assertions have non-empty messages. Five direct assertions near the end of test_state_store lack messages; calling dispose is not followed by a direct assertion that later updates stop. No missing should-only message is reported as a defect. Literal scoped imports found only the wrapper, tests, packaging and docs; production page adoption or per-page runtime isolation is not inferred.",

The final code contains both a direct set reducer and observer sync plus listener effects, so the earliest proposal is not projected literally onto final update order.",

Re-requested review cites a mixin fix and pref middleware changes, but that historical statement does not resolve the actual rest-array cache-branch limitation found in the accepted unchanged source.",
